source: JAH Coffee Guide Database (coffee-guide) record facts

ratios.title: Espresso
ratios.description: Espresso is pressure-extracted intensity: 18g in, 36g out, 25-30 seconds. The base of milk drinks.

ratios.title: Americano
ratios.description: Americano is espresso lengthened with hot water: clean and strong.

ratios.title: Cappuccino
ratios.description: Cappuccino is the classic thirds: dry foam cap, drinkable art.

ratios.title: Latte
ratios.description: Latte is the milky canvas: espresso softened under steamed milk.

ratios.title: Flat white
ratios.description: Flat white is the Australian intense latte: less foam, more coffee punch.

ratios.title: Macchiato
ratios.description: Macchiato is espresso stained with foam: small and strong.

ratios.title: Cortado
ratios.description: Cortado is the Spanish equal-parts: no foam, just balance.

ratios.title: Mocha
ratios.description: Mocha is dessert coffee: espresso meets chocolate.

ratios.title: Cold brew
ratios.description: Cold brew steeps coarse grounds cold for 12-24 hours: smooth, sweet, low acid.

ratios.title: Iced coffee
ratios.description: Iced coffee is hot coffee flash-chilled: brew strong over ice.

ratios.title: Pour over (V60)
ratios.description: Pour over is the clarity method: spiral pours, paper filter, bright cups.

ratios.title: Chemex
ratios.description: Chemex thick filters make the cleanest cup: tea-like and sweet.

ratios.title: French press
ratios.description: French press is full immersion: heavy body, simple ritual.

ratios.title: AeroPress
ratios.description: AeroPress is the pressure hack: fast, forgiving, endlessly recipe-tweakable.

ratios.title: Moka pot
ratios.description: Moka pot is stovetop espresso-ish: strong, nostalgic, Italian mornings.

ratios.title: Turkish coffee
ratios.description: Turkish coffee boils powder-fine grounds in a cezve: intense, with grounds settling.
